title: Detailed treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- shadow under chest -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="88" rx="38" ry="5" fill="#3a2a1a"/>
  
  <!-- chest body - lower box -->
  <rect x="14" y="52" width="72" height="32" rx="3" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x="14" y="52" width="72" height="5" rx="3" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- body darker bottom -->
  <rect x="14" y="76" width="72" height="8" rx="3" fill="#6B3410"/>
  
  <!-- wood plank lines -->
  <line x1="14" y1="62" x2="86" y2="62" stroke="#A0522D" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="14" y1="71" x2="86" y2="71" stroke="#A0522D" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- metal bands on body -->
  <rect x="24" y="52" width="6" height="32" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <rect x="70" y="52" width="6" height="32" fill="#DAA520"/>
  <rect x="24" y="52" width="6" height="3" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <rect x="70" y="52" width="6" height="3" fill="#FFD700"/>
  
  <!-- lid - open, tilted back -->
  <path d="M14 52 L14 38 Q14 32 20 32 L80 32 Q86 32 86 38 L86 52 Z" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- lid top highlight -->
  <path d="M14 38 Q14 32 20 32 L80 32 Q86 32 86 38 L86 42 L14 42 Z" fill="#CD853F"/>
  <!-- lid metal bands -->
  <rect x="24" y="32" width="6" height="20" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <rect x="70" y="32" width="6" height="20" fill="#FFD700"/>
  
  <!-- lid outer curve (open look) -->
  <path d="M14 38 Q14 28 20 26 L80 26 Q86 28 86 38" fill="#CD853F" stroke="#DEB887" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- inner lid visible (open) -->
  <path d="M18 38 Q18 32 22 30 L78 30 Q82 32 82 38 L82 48 Q78 44 72 42 L28 42 Q22 44 18 48 Z" fill="#5C2E0A"/>
  <path d="M22 34 L78 34" stroke="#8B5A2B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- treasure inside - gold coins -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="46" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="44" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#FFEC80"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="9" ry="4.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="8" ry="4" fill="#FFEC80"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="46" rx="7" ry="3.5" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="44" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#FFEC80"/>
  
  <!-- gems among coins -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="40" r="4" fill="#FF4040"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="39" r="2" fill="#FF8080"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="41" r="3.5" fill="#00CCFF"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="40" r="1.8" fill="#80E8FF"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="38" r="3" fill="#50FF50"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="37" r="1.5" fill="#A0FFA0"/>
  
  <!-- pearls -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="42" r="2.5" fill="#FFF5EE"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="41" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="42" r="2.5" fill="#FFF5EE"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="41" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- lock/clasp front center -->
  <rect x="44" y="60" width="12" height="12" rx="2" fill="#FFD700"/>
  <rect x="45" y="61" width="10" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFEC80"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="66" r="2" fill="#8B4513"/>
  <rect x="49" y="66" width="2" height="3" fill="#8B4513"/>
  
  <!-- lock ring -->
  <path d="M46 60 Q46 55 50 55 Q54 55 54 60" fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFFF80">
    <polygon points="20,30 21,33 24,34 21,35 20,38 19,35 16,34 19,33"/>
    <polygon points="80,28 81,31 84,32 81,33 80,36 79,33 76,32 79,31"/>
    <polygon points="50,22 51,25 54,26 51,27 50,30 49,27 46,26 49,25"/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- small decorative feet -->
  <rect x="18" y="84" width="8" height="4" rx="1" fill="#6B3410"/>
  <rect x="74" y="84" width="8" height="4" rx="1" fill="#6B3410"/>
</svg>
